problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Component A: volume 38 m³
* Component B: volume 33 m³
* Component C: volume 65 m³
* Component D: volume 48 m³
* Component E: volume 42 m³
* Component F: volume 53 m³
* Component G: volume 45 m³
* Component H: volume 66 m³
* Component I: volume 35 m³
* Component J: volume 44 m³
* Component K: volume 57 m³
* Component L: volume 50 m³
* Component M: volume 70 m³
* Component N: volume 70 m³
* Component O: volume 48 m³
* Component P: volume 31 m³
* Component Q: volume 34 m³
* Component R: volume 59 m³
* Component S: volume 47 m³
* Component T: volume 70 m³
* Component U: volume 54 m³
* Component V: volume 43 m³
* Component W: volume 40 m³
* Component X: volume 58 m³
* Component Y: volume 30 m³
* Component Z: volume 40 m³
* Component [: volume 30 m³
* Component \: volume 40 m³
* Component ]: volume 66 m³
* Component ^: volume 33 m³
* Component _: volume 35 m³
* Component `: volume 53 m³

Each aircraft has a maximum cargo capacity of 100 m³. Transport all components using the fewest planes possible. Every component must be loaded onto exactly one aircraft, and the total volume in any aircraft cannot exceed its capacity limit.
